feeds.title: Ultimate Tango School Blog
feeds.description: Ultimate Tango offers Argentine Tango Lessons and Classes for adults, teens, and kids. Our goal is to give you a true understanding of Tango structure and music, mechanics of the movement, technique, and cadence. Read our blog to learn about Tango music, connection, lead & follow, types of Tango, and more.

feeds.title: BauTanz Blog
feeds.description: Dance and fitness professional Chrisa Assis teaches people how to enjoy their every dance and get 10Xmore out of their Tango classes, milongas practices. Tips, drills and crunchy solutions to ALL your Tango'y' burning pains! Look and feel amazing..!OWN the next milonga!

feeds.title: Tanguito Blog
feeds.description: Learn with London's highest public rated tango school. They teach the original technique, using modern teaching tools to produce happy, shiny, dancy people. So, if you're looking for something involving with a ton of character and loads to offer, Tanguito tango is for you.

feeds.title: Auckland Tango
feeds.description: This website is for Auckland tango dancers, visiting dancers and potential beginners to get useful, up-to-date information about Auckland tango events, teachers, classes, private lessons, festivals, shoes and other tango-related products and services.

feeds.title: Alex.Tango.Fuego Blog
feeds.description: Blogging On Life, Tango and the Universe

feeds.title: Tango Salón Adelaide Blog
feeds.description: Robert Youngson & Patricia Petronio are dedicated to the improvised tango danced socially in traditional milongas of Buenos Aires. Their classes focus on developing musicality, connection & sound technique, as well as confidence with milonga etiquette.

feeds.title: The Tango Lesson Blog
feeds.description: The Tango Lesson promotes and teaches classic social Argentine Tango dance and music. Connect with and experience the elegant peculiarities and traditions of Tango Milongas. The Tango Lesson is a school of Argentine Tango based out of the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.

feeds.title: TangoAustralia and Angelina's Tango Blog
feeds.description: Promoting and Cultivating Argentine tango in Australia through Dancing, milongas, classes, teachers, events, and music. Explore and experience Music, Dance events near you through the TangoAustralia and Angelina's Tango Blog. Angelina is an experienced Tango artist and coach based in Australia.

feeds.title: Tango Masterclass Blog
feeds.description: Mariano's Tango Masterclass Blog talks about Tango, Mindfulness, and Healthy Movements. Written by certified professional Argentine tango dancers. Mariano is a certified Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction Trainer (MBSR) and Cosima is a certified exercise therapist and lymfedrainage therapist.

feeds.title: Tango DJ Alenka Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my little corner of the Internet. Play some beautiful tango music and stay a while. I'm Alenka Dermol, a passionate DJ and a tango dancer for over a decade. This blog is my way of sharing thoughts about Tango music, tango DJ-ing, tango dancing, and life in Buenos Aires in words and images.

feeds.title: Southern California Tango Championship & Festival Blog
feeds.description: The Official Blog of the Southern California Tango Championship & Festival. Get updates, announcements, guest posts from Tango personalities, and more. SCTC is an annual international tango event in the United States. Uniting people and communities through the shared passion for Argentine Tango music and dance.

feeds.title: Tango Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Discover some of the lessons Tango can teach us on and off the dance floor. Explore the necessary etiquette, Dos and don'ts, and some of the biggest mistakes to avoid for a Tango beginner. The author of this blog, Wolfgang Sandt is a professional tango dancer and tango teacher

feeds.title: Tango Therapist Blog
feeds.description: Reflections on the powerfully therapeutic 'Four M's' of Argentine Tango: Music, Movement, eMbrace, and Mindfulness. Get insightful stress-reducing tips to practice and maintain a healthy mental environment as a Dance practitioner. The author is a writer working at the intersection of Therapy, Dance, music, and Argentine Tango.

feeds.title: Tango Chamuyo
feeds.description: Tango Chamuyo by Janis Kenyon is a blog about the celebration of Tango. She brings back fond memories, shares amusing stories about milongas and milongueros of Buenos Aires, and enlightens readers on funny little trivia about Tango. Janis is a life-long dancer with musical training based in Argentina.

feeds.title: Rio Rhythmics Blog
feeds.description: Rio Rhythmics team is passionate about improving peoples lives through Latin dance and culture. We believe that everyone CAN dance, and that it WILL change your life!

feeds.title: Life Is a Tango Blog
feeds.description: A blog about life, tango and how the two are interconnected, by Montreal dancer Andrea Shepherd, owner of the MonTango Argentine tango school.

feeds.title: Frankie and Clover's Strictly Come Dancing Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2008 to share ramblings about Strictly Come Dancing with the unsuspecting public.

feeds.title: Alma de Tango Blog
feeds.description: Dancer, teacher and choreographer, Hugo Fernández is today regarded as one of the most prestigious tango dancers living outside Argentina.

feeds.title: Tango Space Blog
feeds.description: Tango Space come from a tradition of Argentine milongueros and they are passionate about sharing our love for tango. They want their students to feel free and powerful in their dance. They also organise some of the most popular milongas in London.

feeds.title: Daza Dance Blog
feeds.description: Experience with me the highlights of my passion: Ballroom Dance! At Daza Dance, teaching techniques are based on three planned methods of instruction, which are: Private Lessons, Group Classes and Dance Parties. The combination of these techniques establish skills and develop concepts, building one upon the other.

feeds.title: Los Angeles Tango Academy Blog
feeds.description: Learn intimate nightclub-style Tango in the Buenos Aires tradition! Our focus is social dancing skills; dancing for fun! Free introductory classes every week at LA Tango Academy.

feeds.title: Irene and Man Yung's Tango Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Irene and Man Yung about their experiences and knowledge about Tango.

feeds.title: Connect With Joy Blog
feeds.description: Connect With Joy Blog covers articles about tango history, technique and music. Connect With Joy also shares personal reflections drawings, and tips to help you improve in your dance and always get more joy from it.

feeds.title: Tango Commuter Blog
feeds.description: A complete blog about Tango, its different types and styles, also a detailed knowledge about the history of Tango.

feeds.title: My Tango Diaries
feeds.description: In 'My Tango Diary' the blogger discuss different experiences and aspects of the Argentinean Tango, the dance, that benefit her life and improve her tango.

feeds.title: Axis Tango Blog
feeds.description: Axis Tango seeks out the finest Argentine tango shoes and apparel in the world, offering you curated collections that will exceed your expectations. AxisTango apparel is carefully selected to enhance the elegant flow of the dance.

feeds.title: Moonlight Tango Blog
feeds.description: Moonlight Tango is a not-for-profit association made by dancers for dancers which promotes the benefits of dancing and organizes cultural events, with a focus on Argentine Tango. Check out recent posts to learn more about the benefits of Tango music, dance, and community activities.

feeds.title: Untangomas Blog
feeds.description: The Untangomas Blog is packed with valuable tips and insights to help you and your partner choose the right Tango outfit. From beginners to professionals, everybody can benefit and learn from these articles. Untangomas is a popular online Tango clothing store providing specially tailored Dresses, Skirts, and Trousers for the occasion.

feeds.title: Tango Flow Blog
feeds.description: Learn all you need to know before taking up Tango Dancing. The Tango Flow blog provides excellent tips, and advice on all aspects like Styles, Gear, Benefits, and more stuff related to Tango. Tango Flow offers Classroom, Private and group classes in Munich. Learn Tango courses with young, professional teachers.

feeds.title: You Tango Blog
feeds.description: You Tango blog is a forum for all topics from the fascinating world of Tango Argentino: New, historical, and interesting things about dance, music, fashion, and art. Find expert insights and tips on Tango, Types, and Its representation in Pop-culture in the latest blog posts.

feeds.title: TangoPartner Blog
feeds.description: TangoPartner.com helps you find a nearby Tango partner, wherever you go. It is a platform created to help Tango lovers around the world find local tango friends ready to help them discover the local tango scene.

feeds.title: Tango Therapist's Tango Beat
feeds.description: The Tango Therapist's Tango Beat presents fresh, well-articulated thoughts and reflections on Modern-day Tango dancing across the world. Read more about Etiquette, Common misconceptions, and The 4 M's of Tango: Music, Movement, eMbrace, and Mindfulness.
